           C (  cid,  cname,  city,  discnt )
         A (  aid,  aname,  city )
          P (  pid,  pname,  quantity,  price )
          O (  ordno,  orddate,  cid,  aid,
                        pid,  qty,  dols )
     `'
     (Relational Algebra)

     1) `'
             ((C join O join P) where city '') [pid, pname]

     2) 
            C[cid,cname]- (C join O)[cid, cname]  ((C[cid] - O[cid]) join C)[cid, cname]

     3) 'a001'
             O[cid] - (O where aid 'a001')[cid]

     4) 
             O1 := O, O2 := O
             O[cid,ordno]- ((O1 O2) where O1.cid  O2.cid  O1.orddate  O2.orddate)[O1.cid,O1.ordno]
(SQL )

     
           C (  cid,  cname,  city,  discnt )
          A (  aid,  aname)
           P (  pid,  pname,  quantity,  price )
           O (  ordno,  orddate,  cid,  aid,
                        pid,  qty,  dols )

 SQL  YEAR(orddate) SQL  MONTH(orddate)
         

1 SQL  2015 
 CustSum aid cname, 
total_dols

            Create view CustSum(aid, cname, total_dols)
            As select cid, cname, sum(dols)

                   From O, C
                   Where O.cid=C.cid and year(orddate)=2015
                   Group by cid, cname;

2 SQL 

1)  10000 


2) `'
     Select aid
     From O, C
     Where O.cid=C.cid and C.city='' and O.aid not in (
                           Select O2.aid
                           From O O2, C C2
                           Where O2.cid=C2.cid and C2.city<>'' );

3) 
      
     Select aid, sum(dols) from O group by aid order by sum(dols) DESC;

4)  2014  1  6  100000 
     Select cid, cname
     From C, O
     Where C.cid=O.cid and year(orddate)=2014 and
                  month(orddate) between 1 and 6
     Group by cid, cname
     Having sum(dols)>100000;
5) 
     Select X.cid, X.ordno, X.orddate
     From O X
     Where X.orddate >= ALL (select Y.orddate from O Y where Y.cid=X.cid )

6) 
     Select aid
     from A
     Where not exists ( select *
                                 From C
                                 Where not exists ( select *
                                                            From O
                                                            Where O.aid=A.aid and O.cid=C.cid));
